description: This file defines an interface 'RandomData' that provides various methods for generating random data, including random strings, integers, longs, floating-point numbers, and distributions like Poisson, Gaussian, and Exponential. It also includes methods for cryptographically secure random data and sampling from collections. The interface is marked as deprecated, indicating it is to be removed in future versions.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a non-secure random hex string of specified length.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a non-secure random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a non-secure random long integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random hex string of specified length.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random long integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a random value following the Poisson distribution with given mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a random value following the Gaussian distribution with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates a random value following the exponential distribution with specified mean.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random value in an interval, endpoints excluded.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random value with options for inclusive/exclusive lower bounds.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Returns a random permutation of k elements selected without replacement from n.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Samples k objects randomly from a collection without replacement.
